CODE RED P1A EXECUTION TRANSPORT. This slice proves a real local AMR subprocess path. It is transport and syntactic execution evidence, not semantic validation and not the scientific Baseball vertical.

Immutable starting point:
- approved provider candidate cand-13J7K02VCBNBYWQG8354Y9MGZY at 73bc9af9309c237717b003faaa1a635d0e39a603
- exact admitted external runtime handoff /private/tmp/storymodel4s-amr-runtime.EkToyR/runtime-handoff.json, SHA-256 05b728735f243b6c26bcfd6a09f992f588562a5c7587af2daa0f77940dd7d44c
- runtime, model, tokenizer and dependency binaries remain outside Git
- no paid API, credential, remote source processing, or new provider choice

Exact repository paths:
- build.sbt
- provider-parser/README.md
- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/cache.scala
- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/conforming.scala

- provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/result.scala

- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/ConformingSuite.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/ContractSuite.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/DeterminismSuite.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/TestFixtures.scala

- provider-parser/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parserprobe/ConstructionBoundarySuite.scala
- provider-parser/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/provider/parser/fake-parser.py
- docs/data/provider-parser/runtime-manifest.json
- docs/data/provider-parser/wog-coverage.json

Terminal contract:
1. Implement a concrete subprocess ParserTransport with an exact argument vector and no shell interpolation, bounded timeout, bounded stdout and stderr, exact response bytes, deterministic cleanup, and sanitized logging that never emits source prose by default.
2. A checked transport-execution witness must be joined to the runtime, config, request and observed process result. JsonAmrCandidateProvider must not mint a ProviderCall that claims process execution from response bytes alone. Replacing the live transport with the deterministic fake must be unable to satisfy the real-execution court.
3. Consume the exact PinnedRuntime identity and checked configuration from the admitted handoff. Refuse foreign code, package, checkpoint, tokenizer, environment, config, source ledger, sentence vector or runtime fingerprint.
4. Derive the exact 50 War of the Ghosts sentence inputs from the checked repository SurfaceAtlas. Publish one typed success or failure per input, honest denominator, deterministic outcome digest and exact replay. The required 50 of 50 result means syntactically checked proposition evidence only.
5. Cache and conformance courts refuse foreign input, token echo, provider call, execution witness, checkpoint, runtime, config or cached result. A cache hit retains the original execution authority and cannot manufacture a fresh one.
6. Timeout, nonzero exit, oversized output, malformed response and partial batch behavior remain typed and independently observable.

Explicit nonclaims: no semantic fidelity, held-out generalization, participant transcript result, chart-to-narrative proposal producer, NarrativeCompilation, population estimand or recall alignment. Those belong to P1B.

Gate: run the exact reference-scope-emitted JVM gate from the candidate base, providerParser tests including the live offline runtime court, compileAll and scalafmtCheckAll. Mutation courts must kill removal of argument safety, timeout, output bounds, request or runtime joins, execution-witness admission, fake substitution and cache foreignness. Independent type-discipline and provenance review are required before proposal.
set.title: P1A real AMR transport: pinned runtime and 50-sentence execution witness
